summary: get_url's mode and owner options, with guidance to quote octal modes or use symbolic notation.
questions: How do I set permissions on a downloaded file?
How do I set the owner of a file downloaded with get_url?

answer_card.title: get_url mode and owner
answer_card.answer_md:
- `mode`: quote octal (`'0440'`) or symbolic (`u=r,g=r`)
- `owner`: file owner
